tasks.label: Build
tasks.command: zsh -c 'export IDF_PATH=/Users/mac/esp/esp-idf; export IDF_PYTHON_ENV_PATH="$(ls -d /Users/mac/.espressif/python_env/*/ | head -1)"; export IDF_PYTHON_ENV_PATH=${IDF_PYTHON_ENV_PATH%/}; export PATH="$IDF_PYTHON_ENV_PATH/bin:$PATH"; . "$IDF_PATH/export.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; "$IDF_PYTHON_ENV_PATH/bin/python" "$IDF_PATH/tools/idf.py" build'
